30 s input · 100 tx/s · 1 useful byte/tx · Δ = 1,000 ms · 20 Mbps public egress · natural WAN
Consensus starts at origin-local proposal acceptance. Stages sum over the same fully traced completed-request cohort.
Fault placement differs: Delugi silences Singapore replica 0; saved Raptr pauses Frankfurt replica 1. Native batching/timers differ.
